name: Fighter Combat
summary: A turn-based dogfight, one on one. Each turn you and WOPR choose a manoeuvre at the same time, and a side view shows height, range and who is on whose tail.
howToPlay: Two hits bring an aircraft down: bring WOPR's down to win. DISENGAGE at long range ends the fight even, and so does running out of fuel after 15 turns.
At MANOEUVRE: type PRESS to close in, EXTEND to open the range, CLIMB to build energy, BREAK to turn hard, FIRE to shoot, or DISENGAGE to leave.

FIRE uses a missile at medium or long range (you have two), unless you are on the defensive, and guns at close range, but only from WOPR's tail. A shot you do not have is refused with NO SHOT: and a reason, and costs no turn.
Shots happen first, then both manoeuvres. Each turn WOPR prints both moves, the range, your position (ON ITS TAIL, NEUTRAL or ON THE DEFENSIVE), and each side's energy and missiles.
CLIMB adds 2 energy and EXTEND 1; PRESS costs 1 and BREAK 2. Energy runs from 0 to 6. A damaged aircraft trails smoke (~~) in the picture.

controls.does: turn hard: spoils a shot at you and may shake a pursuer; costs 2 energy
a missile at medium or long range, or guns close in from behind
end the fight even; only at long range
leave the fight and go back to WOPR

tips: Keep your energy at 4 or more. WOPR fires a missile most turns it has a shot, and a missile hits about one time in two against a slow aircraft but one time in six against one with 4 energy or more. A BREAK spoils a shot just as well, but costs 2 energy.
Climb early. A climb that leaves you 3 energy above WOPR moves you a step toward its tail, and so does pressing in with more energy than WOPR, unless it breaks.
Once you are on WOPR's tail, close in and use guns: they hit harder than missiles and never run out, and you have only two missiles.
If the fight turns against you, EXTEND to long range and DISENGAGE. The fight ends even.

After CLIMB you are high with 5 energy and WOPR points away: RANGE MEDIUM. YOU ARE ON ITS TAIL.
YOU FIRE GUNS: A HIT. WOPR's aircraft goes down: the SPLASH ONE burst, WINNER: PROFESSOR FALKEN and the kill ratios.
